# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

The NEXUS project aims to be a constructive, technical community where contributors can participate without harassment or discrimination.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate.
- Critique code and ideas, not people.
- Explain disagreements with evidence and useful alternatives.
- Accept good-faith correction and feedback.
- Respect privacy and avoid sharing other people's personal information.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discriminatory language, intimidation, personal attacks, deliberate disruption, unwanted sexual attention, and publishing private information without permission are not acceptable.

## Applying this code

Project maintainers may edit or remove violating content, close discussions, or restrict participation when needed to protect the community.

To report a concern, contact the repository owner through the contact options on the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/fanxcz). For security vulnerabilities, use the private reporting flow described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/fanxcz/nexus-lang/blob/main/SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue.

This code applies to project spaces, including issues, pull requests, discussions and other official NEXUS community spaces.
